title: Luxembourg-based Hydrosat, which builds AI-based thermal infrared satellite tech to provide data for water resource management and more, raised a $60M Series B (Ingrid Lunden/Resilience Media)
summary: Ingrid Lunden / Resilience Media: Luxembourg-based Hydrosat, which builds AI-based thermal infrared satellite tech to provide data for water resource management and more, raised a $60M Series B — Defence, government and agribusiness customers use the Luxembourg startup's data to track the movement a critical resource: water
